description: Find Dallas County or Collin County, Texas property records in the user's RBSHome account from a street address, appraisal-district account number, lead ID (County:account) or owner name. Returns up to 10 results, each with an id, a title and a url. Call fetch with an id for the full record. Does not filter by criteria; use filter_properties for buy-box lists. Read-only.

query.description: Address (e.g. '1234 Elm St Plano 75023'), CAD account number, lead ID like 'Collin:2771234', or owner name

name: search
title: Search RBSHome properties
